blocks.html: The make and model of unenclosed perimeter protection, along with the connections and supports, shall be acceptable to the registered design professional responsible for the design of the unenclosed perimeter protection in accordance with Section 3308.3.1. The make and model, along with acceptance of the make and model by such registered design professional, shall be indicated as a note on the drawings, or in the form of a signed, sealed, and dated letter from such registered design professional that is kept with the drawings.
